The '''Warsong Outriders''' are the [[Horde]] forces of [[Warsong Gulch]]. They are locked in battle against the [[Silverwing Sentinels]].

==Reputation==
[[Reputation]] is gained through participation in the [[Warsong Gulch]] [[Battleground]]. You gain 35 reputation each time your side captures a flag. This reputation gain is increased to 45 on [[Battlegrounds holiday|holiday weekends]].

==Rewards==
{{main|Warsong Gulch#Warsong_Gulch_items}}
* Players that have exalted with [[The Defilers]], [[Warsong Outriders]] and [[Frostwolf Clan]] receive the [[title]] of Conqueror.
* The currency, {{loot|uncommon|Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor}}, for rewards are earned through participation in the [[Warsong Gulch]] [[Battleground]]. A win for your side yields three marks, while a loss only one.
